title: CausalCompass: Evaluating the Robustness of Time-Series Causal Discovery in Misspecified Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2602.07915v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Causal discovery from time series is a fundamental task in machine learning. However, its widespread adoption is hindered by a reliance on untestable causal assumptions and by the lack of robustness-oriented evaluation in existing benchmarks. To address these challenges, we propose CausalCompass, a flexible and extensible benchmark framework designed to assess the robustness of time-series causal discovery (TSCD) methods under violations of modeling assumptions. To demonstrate the practical utility of CausalCompass, we conduct extensive benchmarking of representative TSCD algorithms across eight assumption-violation scenarios. Our experimental results indicate that no single method consistently attains optimal performance across all settings. translated_title: CausalCompass：评估时序因果发现在模型设定错误场景下的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 从时间序列中进行因果发现是机器学习中的一项基础任务。然而，其广泛应用受到两方面的阻碍：一是对不可检验的因果假设的依赖，二是现有基准测试中缺乏面向鲁棒性的评估。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了 CausalCompass，这是一个灵活且可扩展的基准测试框架，旨在评估时序因果发现（TSCD）方法在建模假设被违反情况下的鲁棒性。为展示 CausalCompass 的实际效用，我们在八种假设违反场景下对具有代表性的 TSCD 算法进行了广泛的基准测试。实验结果表明，没有任何单一方法能够在所有设置下始终取得最优性能。尽管如此，在大多数场景中，表现出更优整体性能的是基于深度学习的方法。我们进一步提供了超参数敏感性分析，以加深对该问题的理解。
tldr: 提出了 CausalCompass——一个灵活可扩展的基准测试框架，通过八种假设违反场景系统评估时序因果发现方法的鲁棒性，并发现基于深度学习的方法在大多数场景下整体表现最优。
en_tdlr: CausalCompass is a flexible and extensible benchmark framework that evaluates the robustness of time-series causal discovery methods under eight assumption-violation scenarios, revealing that deep learning-based approaches generally achieve superior overall performance.
